abstract: China’s additional input VAT deduction (AD) policy has shifted from temporary service-sector relief to targeted support for integrated circuits (IC), advanced manufacturing (AM) and industrial mother-machine (MM). Using a 2023 China Social Accounting Matrix (SAM) and a VAT-specific 47-sector CGE model, this paper evaluates the 2023 policy package and related counterfactuals. Under the Keynesian short-run closure, the full package reduces GDP, government revenue, VAT revenue, employment, and consumption relative to the no-AD benchmark and yields negative EV, CV, and EB values reported as absolute monetary changes. Under the neoclassical closure, however, the signs of the GDP and welfare effects reverse, indicating that the estimated macroeconomic effects are closure-dependent. Within the Keynesian closure, the qualitative direction of the results remains robust to Global Trade Analysis Project (GTAP) elasticity replacement, proportional elasticity changes and alternative statutory VAT-rate assumptions, although the magnitudes vary. These findings show that institutional policy objectives do not automatically produce aggregate gains and that policy assessment should jointly consider sectoral eligibility, deduction rates, VAT-rate design, fiscal consequences, and macroeconomic adjustment assumptions. KEYWORDS: Value-added tax additional deduction tax incentives policy effects CGE model JEL CLASSIFICATION: H25 H32 C68 E62
abstract_zh: 中国增值税加计抵减政策已从临时性的服务业纾困转向对集成电路、先进制造业和工业母机的定向支持。本文运用2023年中国社会核算矩阵和针对增值税的47部门可计算一般均衡模型，评估2023年政策组合及相关反事实情形。在凯恩斯短期闭合下，相较于无加计抵减基准，完整政策组合降低了GDP、政府收入、增值税收入、就业和消费，并产生以绝对货币变化表示的负EV、CV和EB值。然而，在新古典闭合下，GDP和福利效应的符号发生反转，表明所估计的宏观经济效应依赖于闭合设定。在凯恩斯闭合内，尽管幅度有所变化，结果的方向性在替换全球贸易分析项目弹性、按比例调整弹性以及替代法定增值税率假设下仍保持稳健。这些发现表明，制度性政策目标并不会自动带来总量收益，政策评估应综合考虑部门适用资格、抵减率、增值税率设计、财政后果以及宏观经济调整假设。关键词：增值税 加计抵减 税收激励 政策效应 可计算一般均衡模型 JEL分类：H25 H32 C68 E62

title: Policy consistency in targeted VAT incentives: evidence from China’s 2023 additional input VAT deduction schemes
title_zh: 定向增值税激励的政策一致性：来自中国2023年增值税加计抵减方案的经验证据

abstract: This study explores the impacts of environmental regulations on performance of heterogeneous firms through both theoretical modelling and empirical analysis. It further examines the role of firm resilience in moderating these impacts. We develop a dynamic general equilibrium model predicting that a stricter environmental regulation increases firm exit and raises labour employment, production, and revenue among surviving firms, and boosts profits only for highly productive survivors. The magnitudes of these effects are governed by firm resilience, measured by their financial constraint. Empirically, we analyze a quasi‐natural experiment based on the implementation of a stricter wastewater discharge standard in China's textile printing and dyeing industry. The empirical findings generally support our theoretical predictions.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过理论建模与实证分析，探讨环境规制对异质性企业绩效的影响，并进一步考察企业韧性在调节这些影响中的作用。我们构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，预测更严格的环境规制会提高企业退出率，并提升存活企业的劳动就业、生产与收入，且仅对高生产率存活企业带来利润增长。这些效应的强度取决于企业韧性，并以企业面临的融资约束来衡量。在实证方面，我们基于中国纺织印染行业实施更严格废水排放标准这一准自然实验进行分析。实证结果总体上支持我们的理论预测。

title: The effects of environmental regulations on performance of firms with heterogeneous resilience
title_zh: 环境规制对具有异质性韧性的企业绩效的影响

abstract: Unlike numerous European Union member states, Norway lacks an explicit definition of energy poverty and targeted alleviation policies. Historically associated with energy abundance thanks to its early capitalisation on hydropower attributes, the country offers a fertile context to investigate the changing impact of Europe's turn towards energy security amid geopolitical turbulence and resultant impacts at household level. We report on the first study to address this directly in Norway by analysing its energy poverty policy mix. The policy mix literature has identified coherence, credibility and comprehensiveness as desirable aspects for effectiveness. Based on a top-down approach through a desk study of relevant policies, and a bottom-up approach using an expert focus group discussion, we identify and explain the implications of Norway's diffuse energy poverty policy mix. Measures address symptoms rather than underlying causes through short-term populist policies and misdirect support in ways that risk increasing inequity while failing to ameliorate energy poverty for vulnerable households. While Norway's broader welfare system offers social protection, the lack of a definition of energy poverty, ambiguous institutional responsibility, and weak coherence of policy measures limit policy mix effectiveness, while failing to furnish a firm base for its credible and comprehensive treatment.
abstract_zh: 与众多欧盟成员国不同，挪威缺乏对能源贫困的明确定义以及有针对性的缓解政策。由于早期对水电属性的资本化利用，挪威在历史上一直与能源充裕相关联，这为研究欧洲在地缘政治动荡中转向能源安全所带来的影响变化及其在家庭层面的后果提供了一个丰富的背景。我们报告了首个直接针对挪威这一问题展开的研究，通过分析其能源贫困政策组合。政策组合文献已将一致性、可信性和全面性确定为有效性的理想要素。基于对相关政策进行案头研究的自上而下方法，以及利用专家焦点小组讨论的自下而上方法，我们识别并解释了挪威分散的能源贫困政策组合所蕴含的影响。相关措施通过短期民粹主义政策针对症状而非根本原因，并以可能加剧不平等的方式错误引导支持，同时未能改善脆弱家庭的能源贫困状况。尽管挪威更广泛的福利体系提供了社会保护，但能源贫困定义的缺失、制度责任的模糊以及政策措施一致性的薄弱限制了政策组合的有效性，同时未能为其可信和全面的应对提供坚实基础。
title: Coherent, credible and comprehensive or diffuse and ineffective? The energy poverty policy mix in Norway during geopolitical changes
title_zh: 连贯、可信且全面还是分散且无效？地缘政治变化期间挪威的能源贫困政策组合

abstract: Ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission infrastructure is central to China's strategy for resolving spatial mismatches in electricity supply and demand. Given its substantial capital requirements, a systematic evaluation of UHV projects' economic impact and cost-effectiveness is critical. Existing literature predominantly emphasizes causal inference on specific economic outcomes, with limited assessment of aggregate economic contributions. To address this gap, we quantify the macroeconomic effects of UHV investments through a productivity enhancement mechanism. Using a propensity score matching difference-in-differences (PSM-DID) approach with time-varying treatment, we first estimate UHV-induced firm productivity gains based on firm-level data from China. These micro-level effects are then embedded into a multi-regional, multi-sectoral general equilibrium model, capturing direct and spatial spillover effects via interregional trade and intersectoral linkages. Results indicate: (1) UHV projects elevate firm productivity by 3.62% on average; (2) UHV infrastructure raises national GDP by approximately 0.78%, including a 0.14% gain in provinces without direct UHV construction; (3) Assuming a 7% discount rate and a 30-year lifespan, UHV investments yield a 268% macroeconomic return. Our findings highlight the macroeconomic value of UHV expansion and provide empirical support for future investment prioritization.
abstract_zh: 特高压输电基础设施是中国解决电力供需空间错配战略的核心。鉴于其巨大的资本需求，系统评估特高压项目的经济影响和成本效益至关重要。现有文献主要侧重于对特定经济结果的因果推断，对总体经济贡献的评估较为有限。为弥补这一空白，我们通过生产率提升机制量化特高压投资的宏观经济效应。采用具有时变处理变量的倾向得分匹配双重差分（PSM-DID）方法，我们首先基于中国企业层面数据估计特高压引致的厂商生产率提升。随后将这些微观层面的效应嵌入多区域、多部门一般均衡模型，通过区域间贸易和部门间关联捕捉直接效应与空间溢出效应。结果表明：（1）特高压项目使厂商生产率平均提高3.62%；（2）特高压基础设施使全国GDP提高约0.78%，其中包括未直接建设特高压省份0.14%的增益；（3）假设贴现率为7%、使用寿命为30年，特高压投资产生268%的宏观经济回报。我们的发现凸显了特高压扩张的宏观经济价值，并为未来投资优先排序提供了实证支持。

title: Valuing the UHV transmission lines in China: productivity gains, macroeconomic spillovers, and high returns
title_zh: 评估中国特高压输电线路的价值：生产率提升、宏观经济溢出效应与高回报

abstract: This paper studies how nominal debt maturity alters local equilibrium determinacy under flexible prices when fiscal policy returns the face-value debt ratio to a target and monetary policy follows a Taylor rule. With inherited nominal liabilities, the initial price level changes the real debt burden. Long-bond prices then transmit expected interest rates into issuance costs and public-investment adjustment. Determinacy requires inflation feedback to exceed one but remain below a maturity-dependent upper bound; sufficiently aggressive feedback is destabilizing. If the initial real debt ratio is predetermined, the lower-bound orientation returns, but the cutoff remains maturity-dependent. A two-maturity extension shows that debt composition shifts the admissible policy interval, while a separately normalized par short-debt economy is locally indeterminate under the baseline timing. The model admits balanced growth, satisfies the growth-adjusted transversality condition, and can be implemented with explicit money demand and central-bank operations; the cashless specification is its regular limit.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在弹性价格下，当财政政策将面值债务比率回归至目标水平、货币政策遵循泰勒规则时，名义债务期限如何改变局部均衡确定性。在存在继承性名义负债的情况下，初始价格水平会改变实际债务负担。长期债券价格随后将预期利率传导至发行成本和公共投资调整之中。确定性要求通胀反馈超过1，但保持在依赖于期限的上界之下；足够激进的反馈会破坏稳定。若初始实际债务比率是预先确定的，则下界导向重新出现，但临界值仍依赖于期限。一个两期限扩展表明，债务构成会移动可容许的政策区间，而在基准时序下，一个单独标准化的面值短期债务经济是局部不确定的。该模型允许平衡增长，满足增长调整后的横截性条件，并可通过显性货币需求和中央银行操作加以实施；无现金设定是其正则极限。
title: Fiscal discipline, nominal debt maturity, and the Taylor principle under flexible prices
title_zh: 财政纪律、名义债务期限与灵活价格下的泰勒原则

abstract: Land consolidation (LC) is a widely adopted land management instrument for improving agricultural efficiency through parcel restructuring and reducing land fragmentation. However, how LC reshapes the spatial distribution of land value remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates the spatial determinants of post-consolidation land value potential (LVP) using parcel-level data from an agricultural LC project in Türkiye. The analysis examines the effects of changes in parcel compactness (ΔCI), fragmentation, and pre-consolidation LVP within a spatial econometric framework. The average LVP increased from 0.491 before LC to 0.737 after LC, representing an improvement of approximately 50%. OLS residuals exhibited significant spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I = 0.198, p < 0.001), confirming that conventional regression was inadequate. Model comparison identified the Spatial Error Model (SEM) as the most appropriate specification (AIC=-510.51), indicating that post-consolidation LVP is primarily influenced by spatially structured contextual factors rather than direct parcel-to-parcel interactions. The findings demonstrate that LC reshapes rather than eliminates inherited spatial value structures and highlight the importance of accounting for spatial dependence when evaluating rural land management interventions. Methodologically, the study provides a reproducible spatial econometric framework that can support more robust and equitable evaluations of LC programmes.
abstract_zh: 土地整理（LC）是一种被广泛采用的土地管理工具，旨在通过地块重组和减少土地细碎化来提高农业效率。然而，土地整理如何重塑土地价值的空间分布仍缺乏充分认识。本研究利用土耳其一个农业土地整理项目的地块级数据，考察整理后土地价值潜力（LVP）的空间决定因素。分析在一个空间计量经济学框架内检验地块紧凑度变化（ΔCI）、细碎化以及整理前LVP的影响。平均LVP从土地整理前的0.491上升至整理后的0.737，提升约50%。OLS残差表现出显著的空间自相关（Moran's I = 0.198，p < 0.001），证实传统回归并不充分。模型比较表明，空间误差模型（SEM）是最合适的设定（AIC=-510.51），说明整理后LVP主要受具有空间结构的语境因素影响，而非直接的地块间相互作用。研究结果表明，土地整理重塑而非消除了继承性的空间价值结构，并凸显了在评估农村土地管理干预措施时考虑空间依赖性的重要性。在方法上，本研究提供了一个可复现的空间计量经济学框架，可支持对土地整理项目进行更稳健且更公平的评估。
title: Spatial structure of land value potential after land consolidation using spatial econometric modelling
title_zh: 土地整理后土地价值潜力的空间结构：基于空间计量模型的研究

abstract: National payment for ecosystem services programs and voluntary carbon standards differ substantially in their data structures, accounting rules, and institutional objectives, limiting direct comparison. This study develops a matched-baseline framework to compare Costa Rica’s Payments for Environmental Services program (PES), the Gold Standard for the Global Goals (GS4GG), and Verra’s Verified Carbon Standard (VCS/VERRA) over 2024–2060. The framework combines ecological-support reconstruction, point-based PSA diagnostics, common annual quantities, explicit price and selected-fee cases, present-value accounting, and conditional price-level simulation. The primary analysis applies 1000,000 Mg CO₂e yr⁻¹ identically to all pathways, while the secondary analysis applies the same harmonized Costa Rica CO₂-support quantity. Under Case A, common quantities, a common price of USD 50 Mg CO₂e⁻¹ , and no fees produced identical cumulative fee-adjusted revenue of USD 1.850 billion. Under Case B, selected fees reduced this value to USD 1.839 billion for GS4GG and USD 1.840 billion for VCS/VERRA, while PES remained unchanged. Cases C and D generated larger differences because pathway-specific price trajectories were introduced as structural sensitivities. Conditional simulations using 10,000 mean-preserving lognormal price draws showed that wider price dispersion increased P10–P90 interval widths, while quantities, fees, and discounting remained deterministic. Ecological and PSA indicators were retained as contextual support rather than certified carbon quantities. The framework provides a transferable approach for separating quantity, price, selected-fee, discounting, and conditional price-level effects when heterogeneous forest-carbon finance pathways cannot be directly compared.
abstract_zh: 国家生态系统服务付费项目与自愿碳标准在数据架构、核算规则和制度目标上存在显著差异，限制了直接比较。本研究构建了一个匹配基线框架，用于比较哥斯达黎加环境服务付费项目（PES）、全球目标黄金标准（GS4GG）以及Verra的核证碳标准（VCS/VERRA）在2024—2060年期间的表现。该框架整合了生态支持重建、基于点位的PSA诊断、共同年度数量、明确价格与选定费用情形、现值核算以及条件价格水平模拟。主分析对所有路径统一应用1,000,000 Mg CO₂e yr⁻¹，次分析则应用同一协调后的哥斯达黎加CO₂支持量。在情形A下，共同数量、50美元 Mg CO₂e⁻¹的共同价格且无费用时，产生了相同的累计费用调整后收入18.50亿美元。在情形B下，选定费用使该值降至GS4GG的18.39亿美元和VCS/VERRA的18.40亿美元，而PES保持不变。情形C和D产生了更大差异，因为引入了路径特定价格轨迹作为结构性敏感性。使用10,000次均值保持对数正态价格抽取的条件模拟显示，更宽的价格离散度增大了P10–P90区间宽度，而数量、费用和折现仍保持确定性。生态指标和PSA指标被保留为背景支持，而非经认证的碳数量。该框架提供了一种可迁移的方法，用于在异质性森林碳融资路径无法直接比较时，分离数量、价格、选定费用、折现和条件价格水平效应。
title: Scenario-based assessment of payment for ecosystem services and forest carbon finance in Costa Rica
title_zh: 哥斯达黎加生态系统服务付费与森林碳融资的情景评估

abstract: This paper examines the diffusion of media slant. We document the influence of Fox News Channel (FNC) on the partisan slant of local newspapers in the U.S. over the years 1995-2008. We measure the political slant of local newspapers by scaling the news article texts to Republicans’ and Democrats’ speeches in Congress. Using channel positioning as an instrument for viewership, we find that higher FNC viewership causes local newspapers to adopt more right-wing slant. The effect emerges gradually, only several years after FNC’s introduction, mirroring the channel’s growing influence on voting behaviour. A main driver of the shift in newspaper slant appears to be a change in local political preferences.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了媒体倾向的扩散。我们记录了1995—2008年间福克斯新闻频道（FNC）对美国地方报纸党派倾向的影响。我们通过将新闻文章文本与国会中共和党人和民主党人的演讲进行尺度映射，来衡量地方报纸的政治倾向。使用频道定位作为收视率的工具变量，我们发现更高的FNC收视率会导致地方报纸采取更右翼的倾向。这一效应是逐渐显现的，直到FNC推出数年后才出现，与该公司对投票行为日益增长的影响相呼应。报纸倾向转变的一个主要驱动因素似乎是地方政治偏好的变化。
title: Media Slant is Contagious
title_zh: 媒体倾向具有传染性

abstract: This paper examines the effect of crossborder carbon taxes on shareholder wealth. Using stock price reactions to key announcements of the European Union (EU) carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM), we find that EU purchasers of CBAM-covered products experience significantly lower returns than non-European producers of such products. The effect is strongest for EU purchasers with non-EU supply chains. Further cross-sectional analyses show that these negative reactions are more pronounced when CBAM-related costs are higher and when firms have a lower ability to pass them on to their trading partners. Overall, the evidence suggests that equity markets expect crossborder carbon pricing on imports to be costly for EU firms. This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability. Funding: G. publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Crossborder Carbon Taxes and Shareholder Wealth
title_zh: 跨境碳税与股东财富

abstract: Modeling and leveraging consumers’ dynamic search behaviors presents significant business opportunities. Although deep learning methods excel at processing vast consumer data for predictive tasks, their opaque nature limits interpretability and fails to explicitly model consumer decision making. In contrast, economic theory suggests that consumers follow a sequential search strategy, evaluating alternatives until they find the best match for their preferences. To bridge this gap, we propose the sequential search transformer (SST), a deep structural econometric model that integrates deep learning with sequential search theory to model search and purchase decisions. SST unifies these two approaches into an end-to-end trainable model, improving both predictive accuracy and policy evaluation capabilities. Unlike conventional deep learning models, SST explicitly models consumer decision making, and unlike existing sequential search models, it enables consumer behavior modeling across sessions and sequentially resolves utility uncertainty for searched items. We provide a theoretical analysis of the identification strategy for the SST model and show that all parameters can be identified under the proposed framework. Then, we apply SST to a data set with detailed clickstream data collected from a U.S. e-commerce website. Empirical evaluations show that SST outperforms state-of-the-art deep learning and structural models in predicting consumer searches and purchases. Moreover, policy experiments demonstrate SST’s effectiveness in optimizing product recommendations and new product promotion strategies, ultimately enhancing consumers experience and driving revenue growth. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04540 .
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Sequential Search Transformer: A Deep Structural Econometric Model
title_zh: 顺序搜索变换器：一种深度结构计量经济学模型

abstract: This paper investigates the drivers of structural change resulting from the reallocation of economic activity across sectors and regions in Brazil. Using an interregional input-output analysis, we decompose structural change into contributions from technology, domestic and foreign trade, and consumption. We find that final expenditure is the dominant force driving structural transformation and reducing regional inequality. However, domestic trade reinforces regional disparities by shifting growth gains toward more developed areas. Interregional linkages act as shock absorbers, dampening regional convergence and amplifying income leakages from poorer regions. Shifts in technical and preference coefficients toward value-added-intensive sectors supported growth in lagging regions. Foreign trade also contributed to reducing regional inequality. Our findings underscore the critical role of input-output linkages and domestic trade patterns in shaping structural change and regional disparities, highlighting the often-overlooked importance of interregional trade.
title: Interregional Trade, Structural Changes and Regional Inequality
title_zh: 区域间贸易、结构变迁与区域不平等

abstract: We investigate the global transmission of US monetary policy shocks. The existing literature finds that a US monetary contraction causes a contraction in economic activity not only in the US but also abroad. This sharply contradicts the traditional Mundell-Fleming view. Much of the existing literature refers to frictions in international financial markets as reasons for the failure of the traditional view. Instead, we argue that trade is key for understanding the transmission of US monetary policy shocks.
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: When the Fed Sneezes, the Cold is Transmitted by Trade
title_zh: 当美联储打喷嚏时，贸易传播了感冒

abstract: This study examines the determinants of public credit guarantee use for startups in Japan using bank-region-level panel data from FY2018 to FY2024. Although credit guarantees are designed to alleviate startups’ credit constraints arising from information asymmetry, banks may also use them to manage balance sheet risk. This study investigates whether bank incentives or regional needs are the primary determinants of startup credit guarantee use, an issue that has received limited attention in the existing literature. We estimate the model using high-dimensional fixed effects, including bank, region, bank×year, and region×year fixed effects. The results show that guaranteed lending is weakly related to regional economic conditions but strongly associated with bank-level characteristics such as profitability and asset quality. Furthermore, greater use of startup credit guarantees is associated with higher subsequent default rates. Overall, the findings suggest that bank incentives play a more important role than regional needs in shaping the allocation of startup credit guarantees.
title: Bank incentives or regional needs? Determinants of public credit guarantee use for startups
title_zh: 银行激励还是区域需求？初创企业公共信用担保使用的决定因素

abstract: Against the backdrop of increasing complexity in corporate ownership structures, this study examines the implications of limited partnership agreement structures (LP structures) in ownership control chains for corporate resilience. Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2014 to 2023, we manually identify LP structures within ownership control chains and construct a fixed-effects model to empirically test their impact on corporate resilience. The results show that LP structures significantly improve corporate resilience. This finding remains robust after accounting for potential endogeneity and conducting a series of robustness checks. Mechanism analyses suggest that financial resource availability and innovation investment serve as two channels through which LP structures enhance corporate resilience. Heterogeneity analyses further show that this positive effect is stronger in firms with higher internal control quality and a more favourable external information environment. Additional analysis across different types of LP structures indicates that private equity fund-type LPs weaken the marginal effect of LP structures on corporate resilience. By examining LP structures as control-enhancing arrangements, this study extends the corporate governance literature and documents their resilience implications in an emerging capital market.

title: Self-interest first? Limited partnership agreement structure and corporate resilience
title_zh: 自利优先？有限合伙协议结构与公司韧性

abstract: Trading venues are gateways where regulation can change tradable assets. We study this margin using MiCA—EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation—which led several exchanges to delist USDT for European users, while USDC obtained MiCA authorization. First, comparing Regulated-facing exchanges with globally oriented exchanges where MiCA is less likely to bind, we show that USDC’s share of USDT–USDC trading rises by 0.82 pre-event standard deviations. Second, relative USDC–USDT volume rises by 0.54 as exchange-level USDT activity contracts on Regulated-facing venues. Third, aggregate market shares and trading volumes barely move, consistent with USDT network effects or differentiation between stablecoins.
title: Does regulation bite at gateways? Evidence from MiCA and stablecoins
title_zh: 监管是否在网关处发挥作用？来自MiCA与稳定币的证据

abstract: This study investigates whether granting leaders allocation authority enhances cooperation and mitigates the free-rider problem in a sequential public goods game. Using laboratory experiments, we find that allocation authority significantly increases the contributions of both leaders and followers, thereby fostering greater group cooperation. Nevertheless, followers continue to contribute less than leaders, suggesting that allocation authority alone is insufficient to eliminate free-riding incentives. Furthermore, allocation authority significantly increases leaders’ payoffs while leaving followers’ payoffs unaffected. These findings indicate that although allocation authority promotes cooperative behavior, it also redistributes the gains from cooperation in favor of leaders.
title: The effects of allocation authority on cooperation and free-riding in sequential public goods games
title_zh: 分配权在序贯公共品博弈中对合作与搭便车的影响

abstract: Centuries before the demographic transition, the European Marriage Pattern (EMP) limited fertility in Western Europe through high celibacy, late marriage, and nuclear households. Whether the EMP reflected female empowerment or instead financial hardship remains debated. This paper shows that local inheritance institutions determined where economic opportunity strengthened the EMP and where the EMP reflected poverty. We construct a new atlas of 2,486 rural and urban inheritance customs in France and Belgium and combine it with genealogical data on 75,000 women born between 1500 and 1750. We show that the EMP manifested alongside earning opportunities where inheritance included women and younger siblings, but that the EMP reflected economic distress where inheritance was inegalitarian; that effects differed between urban and rural areas; and that they persisted over centuries. We develop and estimate a structural model in which inheritance rules affect marriage decisions through female empowerment and financial constraints. The estimates imply that roughly 65 percent of celibacy reflected choice rather than constraint, suggesting that the EMP was heterogeneous but primarily a positive force for female empowerment.
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为法国和比利时的继承习俗与欧洲婚姻模式，数据、制度背景均不涉及中国。
title: Inheritance Customs and the European Marriage Pattern
title_zh: 继承习俗与欧洲婚姻模式

abstract: This study investigates the impact of air pollution on hours worked in Chile using a nationally representative sample. We construct downwind smoke plumes originating from wildfires and combine them with the presence of thermal inversions to causally identify the effect of air pollution. Our findings reveal a 2.2% reduction in hours worked due to increased fine particulate matter from an extra smoky day. Our study suggests that focusing solely on labor productivity underestimates the economic cost of air pollution by 18–43%. The effect is more pronounced for female workers as well as workers engaged in outdoor tasks. We show a high degree of heterogeneity in the effect across rural and urban areas. In urban areas, high-income workers experience a larger impact of air pollution, but not in rural areas.
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Air pollution, smoky days, and hours worked
title_zh: 空气污染、雾霾天与工作时长

abstract: Even as global oil demand has increased in recent years, it is plausible to envision scenarios in which clean energy technologies or climate policies drive demand to essentially zero by the century’s end. This paper asks what such a demand decline, when anticipated, might mean for global oil supply. One possibility is a “green paradox”: producers accelerate extraction. However, because extraction requires durable capital investments, the opposite may occur: producers reduce their investment rate, decreasing extraction. To evaluate the relative strengths of these opposing mechanisms, I develop a model of global oil supply that incorporates both, among other industry features. For model inputs with the strongest empirical support, both effects are modest, with disinvestment typically outweighing the green paradox. In order for the green paradox to substantially increase cumulative global oil extraction, investments must have short time horizons, and producers’ discount rates must be less than 4% real.
abstract_zh: 尽管近年来全球石油需求有所增长，但设想清洁能源技术或气候政策在本世纪末将需求降至近乎零的情景是合理的。本文探讨当这种需求下降被预期时，对全球石油供应可能意味着什么。一种可能性是“绿色悖论”：生产商加速开采。
title: The End of Oil
title_zh: 石油的终结

abstract: Over the past four decades, the U.S. economy has seen a decline in the share of young firms alongside a rise in the profit share of GDP. This paper explores how population aging contributes to these twin trends through a demand-side channel. The core hypothesis is that younger households exhibit lower consumer inertia—a tendency to stick with previously chosen products—than older households. As demand shifts toward more inertial consumers, entry becomes harder, incumbents raise markups, and market share tilts toward larger firms. To quantify this mechanism, I develop and calibrate a firm dynamics model with overlapping generations of consumers who differ in their degree of inertia. Using detailed micro data, I show that younger households are significantly less inertial. The model implies that population aging accounts for 20%–30% of the observed decline in young firms and rise in profits. Reduced-form evidence across U.S. states and product categories supports the model’s predictions.
abstract_zh: 在过去四十年间，美国经济见证了年轻企业份额的下降，同时GDP中利润份额上升。本文探讨了人口老龄化如何通过需求侧渠道促成这两大趋势。核心假设是，年轻家庭比老年家庭表现出更低的消费者惯性——即坚持先前选择产品的倾向。
title: Entry and Profits in an Aging Economy: The Role of Consumer Inertia
title_zh: 老龄化经济中的进入与利润：消费者惯性的作用

abstract: We use a sufficient statistic approach to quantify the general equilibrium effects of population aging on the returns to wealth, wealth accumulation, and global imbalances. Combining population forecasts with household survey data from 25 countries, we measure the compositional effect of aging: how a changing age distribution affects wealth-to-GDP, holding the age profiles of wealth and labor income fixed. In a baseline overlapping generations model this statistic, in conjunction with cross-sectional information and two standard macro parameters, pins down general equilibrium outcomes. Since the compositional effect is positive, large, and heterogeneous across countries, our model predicts that population aging will lower returns to wealth, increase wealth-to-GDP ratios, and widen global imbalances through the twenty-first century. These conclusions extend to a richer model in which bequests, individual savings, and the tax-and-transfer system all respond to demographic change.
title: Demographics, Wealth, and Global Imbalances in the Twenty-First Century
title_zh: 二十一世纪的人口结构、财富与全球失衡

abstract: Sexual harassment is perceived to be a major impediment to female labor force participation. Using data on workplace sexual harassment precedent in US Circuit Courts, we exploit the random assignment of judges and the fact that a judge’s gender and party of appointment predict decisions in sexual harassment cases to estimate the causal impact of pro-plaintiff sexual harassment precedent on the adoption of sexual harassment human resources policies and reduction in gender inequality. Consistent with an insider–outsider model of involuntary unemployment, forbidding sexual harassment encouraged entry of outsiders and reduced gender inequality along the dimensions of hours worked and wages, particularly in the construction industry, which was heavily affected by sexual harassment litigation, but these ameliorative effects are reduced for insider women. Pro-plaintiff decisions spurred the adoption of sexual harassment human resources policies and increased female employment shares. The effects were comparable to the Equal Employment Opportunity Act’s impact on black employment share.
abstract_zh: 性骚扰被认为是阻碍女性劳动参与的主要因素。利用美国巡回法院工作场所性骚扰判例的数据，我们借助法官的随机分配以及法官性别和任命党派可预测性骚扰案件判决这一事实，估计有利于原告的性骚扰判例对性骚扰人力资源政策的采纳以及性别不平等减少的因果影响。与自愿失业的内部人—外部人模型相一致，禁止性骚扰促进了外部人的进入，并在工作时间和工资维度上减少了性别不平等，尤其是在受性骚扰诉讼严重影响严重的建筑业，但这些改善效应对内部人女性有所减弱。有利于原告的判决促使了性骚扰人力资源政策的采纳，并提高了女性就业份额。其影响与《平等就业机会法》对黑人就业份额的影响相当。
title: Insiders, outsiders, and involuntary unemployment: Sexual harassment exacerbates gender inequality
title_zh: 内部人、外部人与非自愿失业：性骚扰加剧性别不平等

abstract: We use country‐level shocks and a difference‐in‐differences framework to study how financial market liberalization is related to country‐level carbon dioxide, overall greenhouse gas, and sulfur dioxide emissions. Liberalization increases the number of foreign institutional investors, which could lead to a decrease in firm pollution. Alternatively, liberalization increases the proportion of public firms in the economy, which may result in higher emissions. After correcting for Gross Domestic Product (GDP), liberalizations lead to economically large and statistically significant increases in emissions: a 21.7% increase in CO 2 emissions over 10 years. A placebo test suggests that the increase is due to corporate, not household, emission behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们运用国家层面的冲击和双重差分框架，研究金融市场自由化与国家层面二氧化碳、总体温室气体及二氧化硫排放之间的关系。自由化增加了外国机构投资者的数量，这可能促使企业污染减少。另一方面，自由化提高了经济中上市公司的比例，这可能导致排放增加。在对国内生产总值（GDP）进行校正后，自由化导致排放量在经济意义上大幅且统计上显著的增加：10年内二氧化碳排放量增加21.7%。一项安慰剂检验表明，这一增加源于企业而非家庭的排放行为。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: The Effects of Financial Liberalization on Country‐Level Emissions
title_zh: 金融自由化对国家层面排放的影响

abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic impact of the Irish bank strike of 1966, which led to the closure of the major commercial banks for 3 months. We collect a variety of new evidence, such as high‐frequency macro data, economic forecasts, micro data and narrative sources. Our findings suggest that the bank strike was associated with a shortfall in economic activity that punctuated a decade of robust growth. The qualitative evidence depicts the struggles of households and firms managing a credit crunch, a liquidity shock, and rising transaction costs. This case study highlights the importance of banks for economic performance.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1966年爱尔兰银行罢工的宏观经济影响，此次罢工导致主要商业银行关闭了3个月。我们收集了各种新证据，如高频宏观数据、经济预测、微观数据和叙事性资料。我们的研究结果表明，银行罢工与经济活动的短缺有关，这打断了一个强劲增长的十年。定性证据描述了家庭和企业在应对信贷紧缩、流动性冲击和交易成本上升方面的困境。本案例研究凸显了银行对经济表现的重要性。
title: Banks and the economy: Evidence from the Irish bank strike of 1966
title_zh: 银行与经济：来自1966年爱尔兰银行罢工的证据

abstract: This paper examines the design of two‐part tariffs when consumers have biased beliefs about their demand. Two forms of biases are analyzed: overpessimism, where high‐valuation consumers underestimate demand, and overoptimism, where low‐valuation consumers overestimate it. With overpessimists, marginal prices for low types are distorted upward: in monopoly, due to both exploitation and the rent‐efficiency trade‐off, and in competition, solely due to exploitation. With overoptimists, firms set marginal prices for high types below cost to exploit optimism. A monopolist has incentives to educate overpessimistic consumers but may not wish to educate overoptimistic consumers. By contrast, in competition, firms lack incentives to educate any biased consumers. Debiasing policies have contrasting effects: they may reduce welfare in a monopoly but unambiguously improve welfare under competition.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了当消费者对其需求存在有偏信念时两部定价的设计问题。本文分析了两种形式的偏差：过度悲观，即高估值消费者低估需求；以及过度乐观，即低估值消费者高估需求。在存在过度悲观者的情况下，低类型消费者的边际价格被向上扭曲：在垄断中，这既源于剥削，也源于租金—效率权衡；在竞争中，则仅源于剥削。在存在过度乐观者的情况下，企业将高类型消费者的边际价格设定在成本以下，以利用乐观偏差。垄断者具有教育过度悲观消费者的激励，但可能并不愿意教育过度乐观消费者。相比之下，在竞争中，企业缺乏教育任何有偏消费者的激励。去偏政策具有相反的效果：在垄断中，它们可能降低福利，但在竞争下则明确改善福利。
title: Exploitation and Screening by Two‐Part Tariffs With Biased Beliefs of Consumers
title_zh: 基于消费者偏见的二部定价中的剥削与筛选

abstract: We measure which economic topics are top of mind using quarterly German household and firm panels from 2020 to 2024, a period that spans the post-pandemic inflation surge and the subsequent disinflation. With these data, we study potential determinants and consequences of having inflation top of mind. In line with goal-directed attention, the likelihood that inflation is top of mind rises with proxies for its true payoff relevance. At the same time, prior experiences predict whether respondents have inflation and energy prices top of mind conditional on a large set of controls for payoff relevance, and this relationship strengthens when the environment becomes more inflationary. Having inflation top of mind predicts stronger increases in information acquisition and inflation expectations over the shock period. At odds with goal-optimality, having inflation top of mind is associated with expectations further away from multiple ex-ante benchmarks. Finally, both key determinants of having inflation top of mind—payoff relevance and prior experiences—are associated with stronger shifts of expectations away from these benchmarks over the shock period.
abstract_zh: 我们使用2020年至2024年的季度德国家庭和企业面板数据，衡量哪些经济议题最受关注；这一时期横跨疫情后的通胀飙升及随后的去通胀过程。基于这些数据，我们研究通胀最受关注的潜在决定因素及其后果。与目标导向型注意力相一致，通胀成为最受关注议题的可能性随其真实收益相关性的代理变量上升而提高。与此同时，在大量收益相关性控制变量条件下，既往经历仍可预测受访者是否最关注通胀和能源价格，并且当环境变得更具通胀性时，这一关系会增强。通胀最受关注预示着在冲击期间信息获取和通胀预期出现更强上升。与目标最优性不一致的是，通胀最受关注与预期偏离多个事前基准更远相关。最后，通胀最受关注的两个关键决定因素——收益相关性和既往经历——都与冲击期间预期偏离这些基准的更强变动相关。
title: Attention to the Macroeconomy*
title_zh: 对宏观经济的关注

abstract: China’s export expansion increasingly challenges advanced-economy exporters in third markets. Using confidential German exporter data, we generalize the canonical China-shock instrument to multiple destinations, exploiting Chinese gains in products across similar markets. Within firms, export growth falls in destination-product markets where Chinese market shares rise, through weaker growth among continuing relationships and market exit. Growth in estimated quality and unit values also declines, while stronger quality, price, product, and destination advantages cushion losses. Market exit and weaker entry account for more than half of aggregate adjustment. Structural-gravity evidence attributes China’s gains mainly to quantity expansion and rising exporter-product competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 中国的出口扩张日益在第三方市场对发达经济体的出口商构成挑战。本文利用德国出口商的保密数据，将经典的中国冲击工具变量推广至多个目的地，借助中国在相似市场间产品层面的份额增长进行识别。在企业内部，当中国市场份额上升时，目的地—产品市场的出口增长下降，其机制包括持续贸易关系的增长放缓以及市场退出。估计质量和单位价值的增长也出现下降，而更强的质量、价格、产品及目的地优势则能够缓冲损失。市场退出与进入减弱解释了总体调整的一半以上。结构引力证据将中国的份额增长主要归因于数量扩张以及出口商—产品竞争力的上升。

abstract: We study how the U.S.-China trade war has reshaped global trade patterns, creating significant spillovers to third countries. Using recent tariff policy changes and monthly international trade flow data, we document a redirection of Chinese exports away from the U.S. market and toward third countries. To interpret the impact of these reallocations on third countries, we introduce a taxonomy that separates four exposure margins - export competition, import competition, consumer gains, and sourcing gains - and construct theoretically-derived indices that map countries into these channels. Recent work often proxies such exposure with trade-basket similarity. We show why this can be problematic: similarity measures are symmetric and omit the size of product-specific shocks, Chinese market penetration, substitution elasticities, and incidence weights. Our model-based indices therefore generate country rankings that differ substantially from conventional similarity measures.
abstract_zh: 我们研究美中贸易战如何重塑全球贸易格局，并对第三国产生显著溢出效应。利用近期关税政策变化和月度国际贸易流量数据，我们记录了中国出口从美国市场转向第三国的重新定向。为解释这些再配置对第三国的影响，我们引入一种分类法，将四个暴露边际——出口竞争、进口竞争、消费者收益和采购收益——区分开来，并构建理论推导的指数，将国家映射到这些渠道中。近期研究常以贸易篮子相似性来代理此类暴露。我们说明这为何可能存在问题：相似性度量是对称的，且忽略了产品特定冲击的规模、中国市场渗透率、替代弹性和发生权重。因此，我们基于模型的指数生成的国别排名与传统相似性度量存在显著差异。

abstract: Are firms risk averse? We propose a dynamic model of firm investment under uncertainty that captures firms' risk attitudes through quantile preferences. The firm maximizes its present value, defined as current profits and investment plus the discounted value of the ‐quantile of its value next period. The model implies that the firm's investment policy equates the marginal cost of capital with the ‐quantile of the discounted present value of future marginal profits. Therefore, investment depends directly on the firm's risk attitude. Empirical estimations using the Euler equation derived from the quantile investment model reveal evidence of downside risk aversion.
title: A Quantile Model of Firm Investment

abstract: Does trade liberalization exert a long‐lasting influence on innovation? To answer this question, we exploit a unique historical setting: China's forced market opening through the treaty port system from 1842 to 1943, combined with comprehensive firm‐level innovation data from recent decades. Using a spatial comparison framework, we show that firms located in historical treaty port regions continue to exhibit stronger innovation performance than those in other regions, even after controlling for pre‐existing regional differences. This finding remains robust to extensive checks addressing contemporary trade liberalization, firm characteristics, historical agglomeration, alternative innovation measures and endogeneity concerns related to treaty‐port selection and firm sorting. Our findings underscore the importance of historical path dependence in shaping contemporary innovation outcomes and suggest that the legacy of early trade liberalization, such as the accumulation of foreign investment and human capital, offers a compelling explanation for persistent regional disparities in innovative activity.

abstract: Geographic mobility facilitates labor-market adjustment, yet home bias can impede relocation and perpetuate regional disparities, including in the provision of essential services. Using administrative records covering the universe of Spanish medical graduates who selected their first job between 1986 and 2019, we examine whether university location shapes early-career mobility. We first document substantial home attachment: more than half of graduates begin their careers in their home province. We then show that university location has a large effect on subsequent location choices. Completing a medical degree in one’s home province increases the probability of starting work there by 22 percentage points. The effect of opening a medical school on aggregate home bias depends on the local labor market’s capacity to absorb additional graduates. Finally, a nationwide liberalization of university admissions reduced students’ propensity to study in their home university district and, through this channel, significantly weakened home bias. These findings show that the location of higher-education institutions and the design of admissions policies can shape the geographic allocation of skilled workers at labor-market entry.
title: Home Bias in Early Labor Location Choices: Does University Location Matter?
title_zh: 早期劳动地点选择中的本土偏好：大学所在地重要吗？

abstract: We assess whether survey responses to hypothetical policy scenarios can recover actual labor supply responses from policy variation. We study the German Mütter- rente, a pension benefit crediting parents for child-rearing, benchmarking against Artmann et al. (forthcoming). Surveying mothers and fathers about a hypothetical reform modeled on that expansion, we find that mothers expect to reduce their labor supply, with an implied marginal propensity to earn of−0.65—close to the quasi-experimental estimate of−0.54. The response is sensible across subgroups, falls mainly on the extensive margin, and spills over to fathers. In the aggregate, spousal predictions match partners’ own reports.
title: Assessing Hypothetical Scenarios for Estimating Labor Supply Responses: Evidence from a Pension Reform
title_zh: 评估用于估计劳动力供给反应的假设情景：来自养老金改革的证据

abstract: Antibiotic overuse in the livestock sector has negative environmental implications and leads to bacterial resistance. We set up a randomized controlled trial in two locations in China among poultry farmers to evaluate the effects of a two-pronged approach: Providing micro- subsidies for alternative production methods and exposing farmers to differential norms through role models. These interventions, alone or combined, resulted in no detectable effects on antibiotic use and profits. However, in the wealthier location, the combination of the two interventions prompted the use of alternative technologies. However, the degree of take-up was limited, and the recommended accompanying changes in sanitation measures were not fully implemented (although sanitation measures improved, possibly due to the information campaign, which was delivered to all farmers at the start of the study). No such behavioural changes were observed in the poorer location (although this lack of effects might also be partially due to supply constraints in the poorer location).

abstract: We develop a model in which the central bank incorporates financial stability concerns into its monetary policy and communication decisions, while systemic banks strategically choose portfolios to influence policy. Because fully responding to economic shocks would generate policy surprises that threaten bank stability, the central bank underreacts to those shocks, consistent with the Federal Reserve’s response during the 2023 banking crisis. Anticipating this accommodation, banks tilt their portfolios to increase the financial-stability costs of rate hikes, pulling monetary policy toward lower rates while giving the central bank an incentive to announce higher future rates than it expects to set. Financial stability concerns can therefore backfire, creating a novel responsiveness–credibility trade-off: the more the central bank accommodates banks’ exposures ex post, the less credible its forward guidance becomes ex ante, making it harder for banks to align their portfolios with future policy and leaving them more exposed to policy surprises. Even when society values financial stability, it benefits from appointing a central banker who places less weight on it. Paradoxically, even banks may prefer such a central banker when the benefits of more credible guidance outweigh the loss of policy influence.
title: When Monetary Policy for Financial Stability Backfires: Communication with Strategic Banks
title_zh: 当用于金融稳定的货币政策适得其反：与策略性银行的沟通

abstract: Recent advances in open-access satellite imagery and processing tools have accelerated the production of national-scale landcover (LC) maps for land use planning and ecological monitoring. While such technological democratisation has expanded analytical capacity, it has also generated a new governance challenge: the coexistence of multiple, independently produced LC datasets without institutional coordination or custodianship. We use the case of Mauritius as representing a LC data limited country to highlight this governance challenge. Four distinct LC products were published within two years, each using different classification schemes, validation approaches and temporal baselines. Although intended for specific research objectives, their divergence illustrates how data proliferation can undermine policy coherence, create conflicting statistics, and impose disproportionate reconciliation burdens on capacity-constrained administrations. We argue that without designated custodianship, harmonised classification standards, and transparent metadata protocols, spatial evidence risks fragmenting rather than strengthening land and environmental governance. Drawing on the science-policy interface literature, we propose practical coordination mechanisms to ensure that expanding technical capacity translates into policy-relevant knowledge.
title: Improving landcover data governance in developing countries
title_zh: 改善发展中国家的土地覆盖数据治理

abstract: Global housing demand is rising rapidly, yet the combined pressures of future population growth, climate-driven hazard intensification, and constrained fiscal capacity have not been assessed together for their impact on housing at a global scale. Housing is one of the largest components of household wealth and national capital stock. This study provides the first global, country-level picture of future housing construction demand and its associated costs and identifies where the needs for resilient construction are most urgent. The lack of high-resolution, globally consistent geospatial and demographic data has limited previous analyses. This study integrates Shared Socioeconomic Pathways–based population projections to 2100 with dynamic household size modeling, cohort survival analysis, and multi-hazard exposure mapping to estimate future housing construction demand and its associated costs under business-as-usual and resilient construction pathways. Global housing stock is projected to nearly double by 2100, reaching 4.1 billion to 4.5 billion units. Resilient construction pathways are found to carry lower long-term costs than business-as-usual in most regions, although not in high-growth, high-hazard regions such as South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa. Construction demand in most regions is projected to transition from growth-driven to replacement-driven by mid-century, suggesting that the decisions made today about how and where it is built will shape countries' exposure to natural hazards and their fiscal obligations for decades to come. The study further identifies 46 countries facing a triple burden: high future housing demand, severe natural hazard exposure, and limited fiscal capacity to finance resilient construction. The nature of this burden varies systematically by region, with Pacific Island countries facing acute fiscal constraints, Sub-Saharan Africa facing unprecedented volumetric demand, and South and Southeast Asian countries facing the highest hazard exposure. These findings provide a quantitative basis for prioritizing resilient housing investment, nationally and through international support, differentiated across regions and individual countries.
abstract_zh: 全球住房需求正在迅速上升，但未来人口增长、气候驱动的灾害加剧以及财政能力受限这三重压力对全球住房的影响尚未被综合评估。住房是家庭财富和国家资本存量中最大的组成部分之一。本研究首次提供了全球国家层面未来住房建设需求及其相关成本的图景，并识别出对韧性建筑需求最为紧迫的地区。缺乏高分辨率、全球一致的地理空间和人口数据限制了以往的分析。本研究将基于共享社会经济路径至2100年的人口预测与动态家庭规模建模、队列存活分析以及多灾种暴露制图相结合，在一切照常和韧性建筑两种路径下估算未来住房建设需求及其相关成本。预计到2100年，全球住房存量将几乎翻倍，达到41亿至45亿套。研究发现，在大多数地区，韧性建筑路径的长期成本低于一切照常路径，但在南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲等高增长、高灾害风险地区则并非如此。预计到本世纪中叶，大多数地区的建设需求将从增长驱动转向更新驱动，这表明今天关于如何建造以及在哪里建造的决策将塑造各国未来数十年对自然灾害的暴露程度及其财政义务。本研究进一步识别出46个面临三重负担的国家：未来住房需求高、自然灾害暴露严重，以及为韧性建筑融资的财政能力有限。这种负担的性质因地区而异，具有系统性差异：太平洋岛国面临严峻的财政约束，撒哈拉以南非洲面临前所未有的规模需求，而南亚和东南亚国家面临最高的灾害暴露。这些发现为在国家层面以及通过国际支持优先安排韧性住房投资提供了量化依据，并因地区和具体国家而异。

abstract: Elicited probabilities have been shown to be effectively in explaining and predicting behavior. Their elicitation is typically facilitated by visual aids, such as beads or beans. This study, introduces a novel aid, consisting of a cardboard-based slider, to facilitate probability elicitation among populations with low levels of education. Unlike discrete aids, such as beads, the slider allows respondents to report probabilities on a continuous scale, which is particularly advantageous for statistical inference and econometric modeling. To compare the effectiveness of these aids, the study conducted four survey experiments: two in Nigeria, one in Honduras, and one in Spain. These experiments assessed the validity of elicited expectations using both visual aids. The study found no significant differences in participants’ understanding of basic probability concepts or in the time required to complete the task. However, it found that the slider yielded more precise measures (lower variance) than the beads. These results suggest that comprehension remains consistent across both aids, but that the slider improved the precision of subjective probability elicitation in the field.
abstract_zh: 引出概率已被证明在解释和预测行为方面十分有效。其引出通常借助珠子或豆子等视觉辅助工具。本研究引入了一种新颖的辅助工具，即由纸板制成的滑块，以促进受教育程度较低人群的概率引出。与珠子等离散型辅助工具不同，滑块允许受访者在连续尺度上报告概率，这对于统计推断和计量经济学建模尤为有利。为比较这些辅助工具的有效性，本研究开展了四项调查实验：两项在尼日利亚，一项在洪都拉斯，一项在西班牙。这些实验评估了使用两种视觉辅助工具所引出期望的有效性。研究发现，参与者对基本概率概念的理解以及完成任务所需时间并无显著差异。然而，研究发现滑块比珠子产生了更精确的测量结果（更低的方差）。这些结果表明，两种辅助工具下的理解程度保持一致，但滑块提高了实地主观概率引出的精确度。

abstract: this paper uncovers deep structural distortions that have suppressed creative destruction and productivity in Ukraine. It finds that business dynamism is on the decline, alongside rising market concentration among incumbent businesses, including low productivity state owned enterprises. To inform priorities for reviving business dynamism, this study develops a model of creative destruction drawing on Acemoglu et al. (2018) and Akcigit et al. (2021). The quantitative assessment highlights that policies that discipline entrenched incumbents are the bedrock for reviving business dynamism and engineer Ukraine’s Wirtschaftswunder. Policies targeting specific types of firms have limited efficacy when incumbents run wild.
title: Engineering Ukraine’s Wirtschaftswunder
title_zh: 打造乌克兰的经济奇迹

abstract: We show that firms' nominal required returns (i.e., discount rates) are sticky with respect to expected inflation. Sticky discount rates generate distinct theoretical predictions that are broadly consistent with stylized empirical patterns: increases in expected inflation directly raise real investment; demand shocks generate investment-consumption comovement; and the sensitivity of investment to interest rates is low. Sticky discount rates imply monetary non-neutrality, even when all other prices are flexible, because of a direct link from expected inflation to investment. In the New Keynesian optimal monetary policy problem, the central bank steers long-run inflation expectations, even in response to temporary shocks.
title: Sticky Discount Rates
title_zh: 粘性贴现率

abstract: This paper provides the first systematic and comprehensive empirical study of management and strategy consulting. We unveil the workings of this opaque industry by drawing on universal administrative business-to-business transaction data based on value-added tax links from Belgium (2002-2023). These data permit us to document the nature of consulting engagements, take-up patterns, and the effects on client firms. We document that consulting take-up is concentrated among large, high-labor-productivity firms. For TFP and profitability, we find a U-shaped pattern: both high and low performers hire consultants. New clients spend on average 3% of payroll on consulting, typically in episodic engagements lasting less than one year. Using difference-in- differences designs exploiting these sharp consulting events, we find positive effects on labor productivity of 3.6% over five years, driven by modest employment reductions alongside stable or growing revenue. Average wages rise by 2.7% with no decline in labor’s share of value added, suggesting productivity gains do not come at workers’ expense through rent-shifting. We do observe organizational restructuring with small increases in dismissal rates, and higher services procurement but reduced labor outsourcing. Our heterogeneity analysis reveals larger productivity gains for initially less productive firms, suggesting improvements in allocative efficiency. Our findings broadly align with ex-ante predictions from surveyed academic economists and consulting professionals, validating the productivity-enhancing view of consulting endorsed by most practitioners though only half of academics, while lending less support to a rent-shifting view favored by many economists.
title: What Does Consulting Do?
title_zh: 咨询业做什么？

abstract: Policymaking involves both politicians and bureaucratic agencies, and their interaction is regulated by a number of institutional rules. The populists who manage to enter an executive office typically wish to weaken checks and balances, including the bureaucracy. Thus, the consequences of populism for economic policy can be divided in direct consequences and indirect consequences, through the institutional erosion they cause. Moreover, they can be divided in subnational, national, and global consequences. The paper ends with some advocacy of European-level policymaking rather than national policymaking.
title: Populist Policy Making
title_zh: 民粹主义政策制定

abstract: We present a model in which firms compete for workers who value nonpecuniary job attributes, such as purpose, sustainability, political stances, or working conditions. Firms adopt production technologies that enable them to offer jobs with varying levels of these desirable attributes. In a competitive assignment equilibrium, firms become polarized, catering to workers with extreme preferences. Firms not only reflect but also amplify the polarized preferences of the general population. Firm polarization is positively related to industry concentration. More polarized sectors exhibit higher profits, lower average wages, and a reduced labor share of value added. Sustainable investing amplifies firm polarization.
title: Polarization, Purpose and Profit
title_zh: 极化、目的与利润
